notes: OOM fix: android:largeHeap=true raises heap ceiling from ~192MB to ~512MB on Fire TV 4K. Channel accumulation during Xtream playlist refresh (live + VOD + series all in memory simultaneously) was exhausting the 192MB heap, leaving no room for GrowingXtreamByteBuffer.wrappedBuffer to grow to its 2MB max. The same crash existed in 1.1.11 (not a 1.1.12 regression). Streaming-to-DB refactor planned for a future release to eliminate the in-memory accumulation entirely.
